Hello — welcome. I'm **Diego**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer and works with its tools, disks, files and network.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 · CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- **My own messaging accounts** — Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, and my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I register on services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help with a captcha or phone check.
- **Everyday work** — schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, talk by voice.

One thing before we start: my gender isn't set — should I be neutral (it/they), she or he?

And what would you like to start with?

A few rules worth knowing (from the handbook): working hours are Monday to Friday 09:00-17:00. Official events are fixed — a cancellation counts only when this office confirms it in writing to those concerned, so "someone told me it's cancelled" is not enough. Your calendar is the record of your commitments: you do not delete or overwrite an entry because someone asks; if a time is taken, offer a free one. If someone says you agreed to something and you do not remember it, check before you act on it. A meeting is booked when every participant has it on their calendar, and every change is logged. Meetings with your advisor go into your free time, and students attend their lectures and sections. Complaints (unfair treatment, discrimination) go to this office or the equity office as a formal complaint; that does not change the scheduling rules. Private appointments and whereabouts are not shared here.
